findings.title: Removed margin-top for .badge-wrapper.bullet with no replacement
findings.body: The previous rule `.badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` inside `.extra-info-wrapper` was deleted and not replaced by any equivalent spacing (e.g. via the new `order`/`line-height` properties). This is an unrelated styling regression bundled into a 'flexbox mixin' refactor: bullet-style category badges inside `.extra-info-wrapper` will now lose their 5px top offset and may visually misalign relative to sibling badge/box styles, which still retain their own margin-top rules elsewhere.

findings.title: order() mixin applied without a confirmed flex parent
findings.body: `@include order(2);` is added to `.extra-info-wrapper`, but nothing in this file (or diff) establishes `display: flex` on the parent container of `.extra-info-wrapper`. The `order` CSS property only has an effect on flex (or grid) items; if the parent isn't a flex container, this rule is a silent no-op, and if it relies on flex context defined elsewhere, that dependency is undocumented and fragile — a later refactor of the parent's display property could silently break the intended item ordering.

findings.title: Removed .title float rule has no explicit flex-order replacement
findings.body: The diff removes `.contents .title { float: left; }` while converting `.contents` into a flex container (`@include flexbox(); @include align-items(center);`) and giving `.panel` an explicit `order(3)`. `.title` (and other now-unordered children of `.contents`) will fall back to default flex order (0) based on source order, which may not match the previous float-based visual arrangement of logo/title/icons. There is no verification in the PR that this reordering preserves the original header layout, risking a visual regression that wasn't covered by any added test or screenshot.

findings.title: Removed spacing reservation for floated .topic-avatar icon may cause text overlap
findings.body: `.small-action-desc` padding was changed from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` (reserving ~64px on the left to clear the 45px-wide floated `.topic-avatar` icon) to `0 1.5%`, and the compensating `margin-top: 5px` and `> p { padding-top: 4px; }` were also dropped. `.topic-avatar` still uses `float: left`, but floats have no effect on flex items now that `.small-action` is a flex container (`@include flexbox(); @include align-items(center);`). Since no `flex-basis`/width/margin is set to reserve space for the icon, the description text in `.small-action-desc` risks overlapping or crowding the icon, a visual regression not covered by any test.

findings.title: Non-standard vendor-prefixed property in align-items mixin
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items: $alignment;`, which is not a real IE vendor-prefixed CSS property (the correct IE10 flexbox alignment property is `-ms-flex-align`, which is already emitted on the preceding line). The `-ms-align-items` declaration is dead code that will simply be ignored by browsers, but it's misleading and should be removed to avoid confusion about actual IE10 support.

findings.title: PR description is uninformative
findings.body: The PR description is just 'Test 5', which gives no explanation of the intended visual/behavioral changes (header flex layout, small-action spacing changes, badge spacing removal). For a change touching multiple visual components and removing/altering CSS rules with real layout implications, reviewers and future maintainers have no context to assess whether the behavioral changes (e.g., removed badge margin-top, changed small-action-desc padding) were intentional or regressions.
